description: AI-powered state expansion planning tool for OnCourse Systems for Education

stories.title: Create NCES data seed file
stories.description: Create src/backend/nces_data.py with real NCES data for all 50 states: total_districts, total_schools, total_students. Data year 2023.
acceptance_criteria: Each state has district, school, student counts

stories.title: Create Claude API service
stories.description: Create src/backend/services/claude_service.py with async Claude API client for AI-powered analysis. Include rate limiting and error handling.

stories.title: Create scoring service base
stories.description: Create src/backend/services/scoring_service.py with ScoringService class. Include methods to calculate and store scores for each factor.

stories.title: Implement district structure scoring
stories.description: Add district_structure_score() to scoring service. Score based on county-based (like LA=64 parishes) vs fragmented districts (like NJ=600+). County-based scores higher.

stories.title: Implement average district size scoring
stories.description: Add avg_district_size_score() to scoring service. Calculate avg_district_size from NCES data, score higher for larger districts (higher ARPU potential).

stories.title: Implement market opportunity scoring
stories.description: Add market_opportunity_score() to scoring service. Score based on total students and total districts from NCES data.

stories.title: Add NJ and LA baseline capabilities
stories.description: Create src/backend/baselines.py with NJ_CAPABILITIES and LA_CAPABILITIES dictionaries describing current supported features, data elements, submission formats.

stories.title: Implement technical fit scoring with AI
stories.description: Add technical_fit_score() to scoring service. Use Claude to analyze how closely a state's requirements match NJ/LA capabilities. Cache results.

stories.title: Implement development effort scoring with AI
stories.description: Add development_effort_score() to scoring service. Use Claude to estimate effort based on DOE website complexity and existing capabilities. This is the PRIMARY factor.

stories.title: Implement certification complexity scoring
stories.description: Add certification_complexity_score() to scoring service. Score based on whether state requires formal vendor certification vs open market.

stories.title: Implement competitive landscape scoring
stories.description: Add competitive_landscape_score() to scoring service. Score based on density of national/regional SIS competitors in state. Less competition = higher score.

stories.title: Implement geographic proximity scoring
stories.description: Add geographic_proximity_score() to scoring service. Score based on distance from NJ (current HQ). Closer states score slightly higher for support ease.

stories.title: Create score calculation endpoint
stories.description: Add POST /api/rankings/calculate endpoint to trigger score calculation for all states. Returns job status.

stories.title: Add ranking factor weight update endpoint
stories.description: Add PATCH /api/rankings/factors/{id} endpoint to update factor weights. Allows configuring ranking importance.

stories.title: Create ranking weights configuration UI
stories.description: Add ranking factor weights configuration section to /rankings page. Allow adjusting weights with sliders or inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Slider or number inputs for each factor

stories.title: Add state detail API endpoint
stories.description: Add GET /api/states/{id}/detail endpoint returning full state data including NCES data, all scores, and requirements.

stories.title: Create state detail page
stories.description: Create /states/[id] page in frontend showing full state details, scores breakdown, and NCES data.
acceptance_criteria: Shows state name and DOE link

stories.title: Add sorting and filtering to rankings
stories.description: Update /rankings page with sorting by any column and filtering by minimum score threshold.

stories.title: Validate NJ and LA rankings
stories.description: Write validation test ensuring NJ and LA appear in appropriate positions (LA should rank favorably due to parish model). Add test file.

stories.title: Create ranking methodology documentation
stories.description: Create /rankings/methodology page explaining all ranking factors, weights, and data sources. Include LA benchmark story.

stories.title: Create dashboard page layout
stories.description: Create /dashboard page with grid layout for widgets. Include header with navigation and main content area.

stories.title: Create executive summary widget
stories.description: Add executive summary widget to dashboard showing key metrics: total states analyzed, top 3 recommendations, and analysis status.

stories.title: Create top states widget
stories.description: Add widget showing top 10 ranked states with scores. Link each state to detail page.

stories.title: Create tier classification model
stories.description: Add tier field to StateScore model. Tier 1: scores > 70, Tier 2: 50-70, Tier 3: < 50. Create migration.

stories.title: Add tier indicators to UI
stories.description: Add color-coded tier badges to rankings table and state detail pages. Tier 1: green, Tier 2: yellow, Tier 3: red.

stories.title: Create Tier 2 analysis model
stories.description: Create StateAnalysis model for deep Tier 2/3 analysis. Include fields for detailed requirements, competitive intel, and AI insights.

stories.title: Create Tier 2 analysis service
stories.description: Create analysis_service.py with methods to perform deep analysis using Claude. Analyze reporting requirements, competitive landscape, certification process.

stories.title: Perform Tier 2 analysis for Pennsylvania
stories.description: Run deep analysis for PA. Research PIMS reporting system, certification requirements, major competitors. Store results.

stories.title: Perform Tier 2 analysis for Texas
stories.description: Run deep analysis for TX. Research PEIMS/TSDS reporting, TEA requirements, major competitors. Store results.

stories.title: Perform Tier 2 analysis for Maryland
stories.description: Run deep analysis for MD. Research county-based system (24 LEAs), MSDE requirements, competitors. Store results.

stories.title: Create Tier 2 analysis API endpoint
stories.description: Add GET /api/states/{id}/analysis endpoint returning deep analysis data for a state.

stories.title: Add analysis section to state detail page
stories.description: Update /states/[id] page to show Tier 2 analysis data if available. Display competitive intel, requirements, and AI insights.

stories.title: Create state comparison API endpoint
stories.description: Add GET /api/states/compare?ids=1,2 endpoint returning side-by-side data for 2+ states.

stories.title: Create state comparison page
stories.description: Create /compare page with side-by-side state comparison. Allow selecting 2-3 states to compare scores and data.

stories.title: Add radar chart component
stories.description: Create radar chart component using Recharts to visualize state scores across all 9 factors.

stories.title: Add bar chart for rankings
stories.description: Create bar chart showing top 10 state scores on dashboard. Horizontal bars with state names and scores.

stories.title: Add charts to state detail page
stories.description: Add radar chart to state detail page showing score breakdown. Add comparison to NJ/LA baselines.

stories.title: Implement simple password authentication
stories.description: Add /api/auth/login endpoint with simple password check from config. Return session token. Add middleware for protected routes.

stories.title: Create login page
stories.description: Create /login page with password input. Redirect to dashboard on success. Store token in localStorage.

stories.title: Protect pages with auth check
stories.description: Add auth check to all pages except login. Redirect to login if not authenticated. Show loading state during check.

stories.title: Create Gap model for requirements gaps
stories.description: Create Gap model to track missing requirements between target state and NJ/LA baselines. Include fields for gap type, severity, effort estimate.
acceptance_criteria: Fields: state_id, baseline_state, gap_type, description, severity, effort_hours

stories.title: Create GapAnalysis model for analysis results
stories.description: Create GapAnalysis model to store full gap analysis results for a state. Includes summary, total effort, timeline projection.
acceptance_criteria: Fields: state_id, baseline_used, total_gaps, critical_gaps, total_effort_hours, projected_months

stories.title: Expand NJ baseline with detailed capabilities
stories.description: Expand baselines.py NJ_CAPABILITIES with detailed feature list including data elements, submission formats, integrations, and workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Categories: enrollment, attendance, grades, special_ed, assessments
Each feature has name, description, complexity

stories.title: Expand LA baseline with detailed capabilities
stories.description: Expand baselines.py LA_CAPABILITIES with detailed feature list. Document parish model specifics and what made LA expansion successful.

stories.title: Create gap detection service
stories.description: Create gap_service.py with methods to compare target state requirements against NJ/LA baselines and identify gaps.

stories.title: Implement gap effort estimation
stories.description: Add effort estimation logic to gap service. Estimate hours based on gap type and complexity using LA benchmark data.
acceptance_criteria: Returns effort in hours and FTE-months

stories.title: Create gap analysis API endpoints
stories.description: Add /api/gap-analysis endpoints for running analysis, retrieving results, and listing gaps for a state.

stories.title: Run gap analysis for Pennsylvania
stories.description: Execute gap analysis for PA comparing against NJ baseline. Identify PIMS-specific gaps and estimate effort.

stories.title: Run gap analysis for Texas
stories.description: Execute gap analysis for TX comparing against NJ/LA baselines. Identify PEIMS-specific gaps and estimate effort.

stories.title: Run gap analysis for Maryland
stories.description: Execute gap analysis for MD comparing against LA baseline (county model). Identify MSDE gaps and estimate effort.

stories.title: Create gap analysis page
stories.description: Create /gap-analysis page showing gap analysis results for top states with summary cards and gap list.

stories.title: Create state gap detail page
stories.description: Create /gap-analysis/[id] page showing detailed gaps for a state with filtering and sorting.

stories.title: Add gap visualization chart
stories.description: Add chart component showing gap distribution by category and severity using Recharts.

stories.title: Implement effort estimation display
stories.description: Add effort estimation section to gap analysis page showing total hours, FTE-months, and timeline projection.

stories.title: Create timeline projection view
stories.description: Add timeline visualization showing projected implementation phases and milestones for each state.
acceptance_criteria: Shows phases: Research, Dev, Testing, Cert

stories.title: Add gap comparison view
stories.description: Create view to compare gaps across multiple states side-by-side showing relative effort and complexity.

stories.title: Create executive summary report
stories.description: Create printable executive summary component with top 3 recommendations, key metrics, and action items.

stories.title: Add gap analysis to navigation
stories.description: Add Gap Analysis link to main navigation and dashboard quick actions.

stories.title: Create validation checklist
stories.description: Create validation checklist component for stakeholder review of rankings and gap analysis results.

stories.title: Add export functionality for reports
stories.description: Add ability to export gap analysis and rankings data as CSV for stakeholder review.
